title: Identifying disease progression biomarkers in metabolic associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) through weighted gene co-expression network analysis and machine learning.
authors: Zhang, Weiliang; Lu, Weirong; Jiao, Yaqi; Li, Tianhao; Wang, Haining; Wan, Chunhua
one_liner_zh: 该文通过WGCNA和机器学习识别MASLD进展生物标志物，虽涉及转录因子探索但核心为基因表达与疾病诊断，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Metabolic Associated Steatotic Liver Disease (MASLD), encompassing conditions simple liver steatosis (MAFL) and metabolic associated steatohepatitis (MASH), is the most prevalent chronic liver disease. Currently, the management of MASLD is impeded by the lack of reliable diagnostic biomarkers and effective therapeutic strategies. METHODS: We analyzed eight independent clinical MASLD datasets from the GEO database. Differential expression and weighted gene co-expression network analyses (WGCNA) were used to identify 23 genes related to inflammation. Five hub genes were selected using machine learning techniques (SVM-RFE, LASSO, and RandomForest) combined with a literature review. Nomograms were created to predict MASLD incidence, and the diagnostic potential of the hub genes was evaluated through receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curves. Additionally, Protein-Protein Interaction (PPI) networks, functional enrichment, and immune infiltration analyses were performed. Potential transcription factors and therapeutic agents were also explored. Finally, the expression and biological significance of these hub genes were validated using MASLD animal model, histological examination and transcriptomic profiles. RESULTS: We identified five hub genes-UBD/FAT10, STMN2, LYZ, DUSP8, and GPR88-that are potential biomarkers for MASLD. These genes exhibited strong diagnostic potential, either individually or in combination. CONCLUSION: This study highlights five key biomarkers as promising candidates for understanding MASLD. These findings offer new insights into the disease's pathophysiology and may contribute to the development of better diagnostic and therapeutic approaches.
abstract_zh: 背景：代谢相关脂肪性肝病（MASLD），包括单纯性肝脏脂肪变性（MAFL）和代谢相关脂肪性肝炎（MASH），是最常见的慢性肝病。目前，MASLD的管理因缺乏可靠的诊断生物标志物和有效的治疗策略而受阻。方法：我们分析了来自GEO数据库的八个独立临床MASLD数据集。通过差异表达和加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）识别出23个与炎症相关的基因。利用机器学习技术（SVM-RFE、LASSO和RandomForest）结合文献综述筛选出五个核心基因。构建列线图以预测MASLD发病率，并通过受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线评估核心基因的诊断潜力。此外，还进行了蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络、功能富集和免疫浸润分析。同时探索了潜在的转录因子和治疗药物。最后，使用MASLD动物模型、组织学检查和转录组谱验证了这些核心基因的表达及其生物学意义。结果：我们识别出五个核心基因——UBD/FAT10、STMN2、LYZ、DUSP8和GPR88——作为MASLD的潜在生物标志物。这些基因单独或联合使用时均表现出较强的诊断潜力。结论：本研究强调了五个关键生物标志物作为理解MASLD的有前景候选者。这些发现为疾病的病理生理学提供了新见解，并可能有助于开发更好的诊断和治疗方法。
